'''''Star Wars: Darth Maul — Death Sentence''''' also stylized '''''Darth Maul: Death Sentence''''' or '''''Darth Maul—Death Sentence''''', is a four-issue comic book miniseries from Dark Horse Comics written by [[Tom Taylor]].

The story is set between the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (graphic novellas)|digest-sized graphic novel]] "[[The Clone Wars: The Sith Hunters|The Sith Hunters]]," and the "[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|Star Wars: Clone Wars]]" [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|Season 5]] premiere episode "[[Revival (episode)|Revival]]."
